definitions.explanation: A line of poetry, especially haiku.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{句|く}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand the meaning of this phrase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{慣用句|かんようく}→慣用句：15890_kanyouku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{松尾芭蕉|まつおばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句|く}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: To read verses by Matsuo Basho.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句|く}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}した→分析：03610_bunseki⟧。
examples.english: I analyzed each phrase in the sentence one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{句|く}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to compose verses using seasonal words.

notes:
{句|く} refers to a phrase, clause, or line of verse. It's a fundamental unit in both grammar and poetry.

USAGE:
1. Grammatical phrase or clause (linguistic unit)
2. A verse or line in poetry, especially haiku

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧: haiku (17-syllable poem)
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: complaint; phrase, wording
- ⟦{語句|ごく}→語句：02840_goku⟧: words and phrases
- ⟦{句読点|くとうてん}→句読点：08650_kutouten⟧: punctuation marks
- ⟦{慣用句|かんようく}→慣用句：15890_kanyouku⟧: idiomatic expression
- ⟦{成句|せいく}→成句：22388_seiku⟧: set phrase, idiom

POETRY CONTEXT:
In haiku, {句|く} refers to each 5-7-5 segment: ⟦{上|かみ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句|く} (first line), ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句|く} (middle line), ⟦{下|しも}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{句|く} (last line).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {句|く}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧: to compose a verse
- {句|く}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to write a poem/verse
